title: docs(pm-dispatch): Tier S landed from a project needs a review of record by another account; the 分诊席 shrinks to bare cards; decision cards stay in their repo and the 总监席 scans every repo
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DT9BzcHzTUTCpkAMQnkTEXC)_

Fixes #25414

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:把您 2026-10-23 在「车队机制迁往 Projects」线程的话写进 pm-dispatch 六个细则文件。① 项目席落地 Tier S 的前提多一条:契约复核记录的 `Reviewed-by:` 会话必须属于 PR 作者之外的账户(记录另带一行 `Reviewed-by-account:` 写复核账户的 login,须异于 PR 正文 attribution 的 github_login,与 #25415 队列守卫读的键一致);同账户的隔离子代理只算复核、不作落地记录;只动散文面的 PR 同样欠另一账户一条 TIER_DEFAULT 记录;过渡期没有另一账户在席时,仍以您本人在执行线程逐个点名 PR 编号为替代。② `pm:mailbox` 信箱 PR 不欠 CI、永不入队、台账查询排除。③ 每个项目的巡查多一项:扫 `needs:contract-review` 的 open PR、剔除本账户署名的、留 Claim 形评论再复核、PASS 同笔摘标;总监席摘要列等候逾 24 小时的 PR。④ 分诊席缩为薄席:只做 objectstack、objectui 两仓裸卡的首触定级与路由、跨车道查重,只写标签与审计评论;半标卡归所属车道席补齐;应用仓无分诊席;发版板、pin 链、决策箱勤务移到总监席章程,fork PR 扫描与 hold 解锁重验移到车道巡查。⑤ 决策卡留在立卡仓,总监席扫全部仓的 `needs-user-decision` 按批呈您;pin 链扩到每个应用仓;新仓清单加 GOVERNED_REPOS、车队 App、车道宪章文件。
- **为什么改**:您的原话(卡 #25414 正文):「分诊不忙不如留给总监管」(12:08Z)、「为什么我们需要区分项目类型?任何一个项目中都可以召唤总监啊,任何一个项目中也可以召唤分诊」(12:25Z)、「你立卡并派发处理所有相关任务,跟踪落地」(12:13Z)。实测依据:06:04Z 至 06:16Z 三个席位的落地只在您本人逐个点名 PR 时放行;#25363 由另一账户复核后作者席位一分钟内自落,无人点名。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯规则文本;triage-duties.md 120→103 行,lanes/director.md 70→87 行,其余五个文件净零;棘轮以跨文件迁移申报付账,总上限不升;一次 revert 可回。两处要您知道:① 本 PR 在 #25412(项目形态,写 `project-forms.md`)之后落地,lanes/director.md 里的「车队总表…见 project-forms.md」指针与「总监席无 Routine」那行的调和在 #25412 合入后再对齐一次;② 分诊席的人工决裁底线(风险判据、工作量判据、人工地板、不呈清单)原文未动。
- **席位意见**:(席位复核后填)
- **你要做的(一个动作)**:等 #25412 落地、席位对本 PR 新 head 的契约复核 PASS、CI 全绿后,在席位线程回「objectstack-ai/objectstack#本 PR 编号 可以落地」。本 PR 写的规则(另一账户的复核记录即放行)要等它自己合入才生效。

## What changed

Seven files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**` plus the ceiling rows in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`; rule text only; every edited line is at or under 120 bytes.

| File | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `contract-review.md` 独立性对 (48 → 53, ceiling 60) | the pair is read off `--template` | +3: a project seat's Tier S landing needs a `Reviewed-by:` from an account other than the PR author's: the record carries a `Reviewed-by-account:` line (the reviewing session's login) beside `Reviewed-by:`, and it must differ from the PR body attribution `github_login` (the same key and comparison the #25415 queue guard reads); a same-account isolated subagent is a review, not the record; a prose-only PR owes one cross-account `TIER_DEFAULT` record. +2 beside 落地前检: ① gains the account condition for project seats; the interim rule while no other account is seated is the maintainer's own message naming each PR number. The card names `landing-operations.md` for item 2, but the 落地前检两条 lines live here since the rules-only rewrite, so the text went where the rule is |
| `landing-operations.md` 入队与落地 (101, net 0) | — | +1 `pm:mailbox`: owes no CI, never queued, excluded from the landing ledger and orphan-PR queries; paid by folding 「外部评审链降为可选事后审计」 into the design-fork line |
| `dispatch-runbook.md` (241, net 0) | 〈座位贴活性巡查(分诊轮常设项)〉, six lines run by the triage Routine | 〈巡查常设项(每项目巡查与总监席摘要)〉: seat-post liveness goes to the 总监席 digest (3 lines, same tests); the cross-account review pass (3 lines: the `is:pr is:open label:needs:contract-review` query minus this account's attribution, the `Claim:`-shaped comment before reviewing, review per `contract-review.md`, strip the marker on PASS, the digest lists PRs waiting over 24 h); the lane patrol takes hold/closed re-validation and the fork-PR sweep (1 line). Paid by merging two 读数成本 lines. 〈分诊两级盘点细则〉: 四仓 → 两仓; `Restart-when:` batch scan → lane patrol, inbox back-fill → 总监席; sweep disjuncts ①②③ → ①② |
| `triage-duties.md` (120 → 103) | the full triage duty list | the seat keeps bare-card first touch and cross-lane dedupe; disjunct ② stays (queue label, no domain), the half-labelled ③④ go to the owning lane seat; 全仓 → 两仓; the fork-PR sweep, the pin chain (6), the decision-inbox duties (3), the closed/`Restart-when:` re-validation (2) and the release board (5) leave; line 5 names where the release board, pin chain and in-flight liveness went (总监席 digest, details staying here). Lines 95–120 (人工地板, 风险判据, 工作量判据, 不呈 list, 例外一/二) are untouched |
| `lanes/triage.md` (7, net 0) | pickup alternation and the starvation guard | summoned by the maintainer's sentence into any project, by default beside the 总监席; labels and audit comments only, no PR, no claim; scope = objectstack/objectui bare cards + cross-lane dedupe, app repos have no triage seat; the alternation, 4 h starvation guard, no-second-seat and no-frequency-change rules kept |
| `lanes/director.md` (70 → 87) | 决裁勤务 inbox line | +1 授权与形态: the 分诊席 is summoned beside this seat by default, its hourly run may share the inbox scan. 职责二 +2: the inbox is every repo's `needs-user-decision`, cards stay in the repo they were filed in; the two 入箱勤务 lines moved from triage-duties. New 职责四 (+12): the daily digest line (in-flight / awaiting ruling / awaiting landing / wall notes, PRs waiting over 24 h for review, release board, pin lag, cardless fork PRs); seat-post and in-flight liveness; the release board (5 lines moved, main-repo producer now this seat); the pin chain (3 lines, extended to every app repo); the roster regenerated by the digest, pointing at `project-forms.md` (sibling card #25412) |
| `cross-repo-coordination.md` (51, net 0) | 「决策收件箱按仓:平台在 objectstack / objectui,元数据项目在本仓」 | 「决策卡留在立卡仓,总监席扫全部仓 `needs-user-decision` 呈批」; the new-repo checklist gains `GOVERNED_REPOS`, the fleet App and the lane charter file, and names 「应用仓无分诊席」; paid by merging the 准入 and hotcrm-charter lines |
| `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` | — | `triage-duties.md` 120 → 103, `lanes/director.md` 70 → 87, declared as one CROSS_FILE_MOVE (destination director.md, was 70; source triage-duties.md, was 120): +17 against a net source decrease of 17, map total unchanged |

Acceptance checks on this head: `git grep -n '决策收件箱按仓' -- .claude/skills` → no hit; `git grep -n 'os-bill\|hotlong\|os-elon-musk' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/` → no hit; no rule line names a login.

## Gates

On `f779162`: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` ✓ (self-test 164 cases; declared cross-file moves 3, total ceilings down 486; every covered file at or under its ceiling), `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` ✓ (87 files clean), `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` ✓, `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` ✓, `scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` ✓. No published package moves (`.claude/**` and one ceiling file), so `skip-changeset`.

## Ordering and open PRs

- Lands after #25412 (sibling card, `project-forms.md`). Its PR was not open at this push; when it lands, `main` is merged in here and two spots are re-read: the `project-forms.md` pointer in `lanes/director.md` 职责四, and 授权与形态 line 「⛔ 无 Routine、无 cron、无舰队位」 against the hourly inbox scan and daily digest that card writes.
- Open PRs on the same tree at push time: #25385 (`dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 L141–L142, `lanes/director.md` L1), #25255 (new `coordinator.md`, runbook L136), #25247 (lane files). This PR touches none of their hunks (runbook L39–L46, L52–L53, L64, L69–L70; director.md L22, L51, L68).

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance names a `record-recognisers.mjs --template` run that shows where the account line goes; `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` is outside this claim's file surface (devx S card, same stroke as the queue-guard check). Until that lands, the reviewer adds the `Reviewed-by-account:` line by hand beside `Reviewed-by:`, as `contract-review.md` now says; the key name is the one the #25415 queue guard reads, so the two PRs agree without waiting for the template change.
- `seat-post-protocol.md` 发版板运维 still reads 「生产者:主仓归分诊座位」; `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈座位贴协议〉 still says the triage round releases a silent claim, and its 轮次报告 line still counts disjunct ④. All three files are outside this claim's surface (and #25385 edits the first two); one-line follow-ups for the seat: 「主仓归总监席」, 「由总监席摘要一笔中继释放」, 「析取④ → 车道席补齐」.
- The 在飞活性复查 lines (knock, `RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS`, `Release:`) stay in `triage-duties.md` because `seat-lifecycle.md` points there; line 5 of that file names the 总监席 digest as the run that executes them.
- The body's first line is the HTML-comment attribution block the project session requires; `os-dev.md` 〈干净收尾〉 forbids HTML comments in GitHub text. Reported as a deviation, not hidden.

Governed surface `.claude/**` (Tier S): draft, awaiting the seat's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review and the maintainer's word; ⛔ not to be flipped ready, queued or armed by this thread.
